$comment: Every EVM address that may appear in PayLink documentation. Source of truth for real-chain addresses: PAYLINK-V2-SPEC §3.4 (EIP-55 checked with viem on 2026-10-05) and, once it exists, the generated registry in packages/chains. Test fixtures are anvil's public default accounts and the addresses anvil assigns to the first contracts deployed by account 0. docs/tools/check-docs.py fails on any address that is not listed here, on any listed mixed-case address whose EIP-55 checksum is wrong, and on any mention of a `never` address on a line that does not say it must not be used. Add an address only with its source and confidence tag, in the same pull request that documents it.
